snippet.title: Feed the Cups // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2336220/Feed_the_Cups/

Feed the Cups is a Roguelite multiplayer online cooperative game. Run a Drink Shop, stocking up, preparing ingredients, taking orders, crafting drinks, cleaning up, and checking equipment. Join your friends together

👥 Players: Single Player, Online Co-op
🛠️ Developer: Vambear Games
📚 Publisher: IndieArk
📅 Early Release Date: Feb 21, 2024
📅 Release Date: Oct 16, 2026
🎯 Genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation
